facts.value: 1812-13 among Particular Baptists. General Baptists of the New Connexion joined 1891

citations.locator: Baptist Union of Great Britain, member profile
citations.excerpt: The influence of the Baptist Missionary Society, founded in 1792, led to the formation in 1812-13 of the first Baptist Union amongst Particular Baptist churches.
This process culminated in 1891, when the General Baptists of the New Connexion amalgamated with the Baptist Union.
